verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud, and a cloud platform could plausibly offer versioned, reviewable, rollback-capable automation such as launch templates or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only building blocks: the REST API and cloud-init launch-time configuration. Nothing in the pack documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Filesystem 'back up system state' is storage, an adjacent feature, and the CLI/MCP server is unofficial and from the community, so neither earns credit.
